objective: Make Stategraph available as an optional working capability inside the Azure IaC MSP Lab without making ordinary infrastructure work depend on it.
governing_question: Does Stategraph help push the MSP demo lab forward faster and with more confidence?

current_classification.admission_rule: Stategraph may move to Build Now only when it directly closes a Lab v1 completion criterion, removes a material security or operational credibility defect, produces required demonstration evidence, or a later explicit human priority decision changes the gate.

fallback.stategraph_unavailable_behavior: Continue ordinary Terraform validation and planning without Stategraph.
fallback.destructive_change_behavior: Use the standard Terraform path until explicit compatibility and recovery tests pass.

planned_phases.name: Isolated standard Terraform foundation
requirements: fresh repository and Azure reality synchronization
standard Terraform validation independent of Stategraph
backend, identity, cost, region, quota, rollback, cleanup, and evidence design

planned_phases.name: Use during real Terraform changes
requirements: real lab increments rather than artificial benchmarks
recorded speed, dependency, confidence, and overhead observations

signals_to_restrict_or_remove: ordinary Terraform becomes dependent on Stategraph

next_gate.after_merge: Continue Lab v1 completion. Re-evaluate Stategraph Build Now admission only when the completion gate permits it or an explicit human priority decision changes that ordering.
next_gate.claim_boundary: Repository adoption records strategy only. It does not establish a Terraform root, Stategraph runtime, Stategraph account, CI integration, Azure access, Azure deployment, or operational benefit.
